description: This file defines an interface for processing buy-down fee amortization in loans, including methods for processing amortization up to a date, on loan closure, on charge-off, and undoing a charge-off.

classes.name: LoanBuyDownFeeAmortizationProcessingService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for processing buy-down fee amortization activities related to loans.

methods.name: processBuyDownFeeAmortizationTillDate
methods.description: Processes the buy-down fee amortization for a loan up to a specified date, with an option to add journal entries.

methods.name: processBuyDownFeeAmortizationOnLoanClosure
methods.description: Processes the buy-down fee amortization at the time of loan closure, with an option to add journal entries.

methods.name: processBuyDownFeeAmortizationOnLoanChargeOff
methods.description: Processes buy-down fee amortization when a loan is charged off, based on a specific loan transaction.

methods.name: processBuyDownFeeAmortizationOnLoanUndoChargeOff
methods.description: Reverses or adjusts buy-down fee amortization when a loan charge-off is undone, based on a loan transaction.
